title: More ways to make—and take apart—media
summary:
New image and audio options, an Anthropic-compatible endpoint, a busier Polli CLI, and a Bee Census made for written answers.

Lightning Image Turbo adds text-to-image generation guided by up to two reference images. New audio options include Gemini 3.5 Transcribe with speaker labels and word timestamps, ElevenLabs stem separation, and two OpenAI TTS models with six voices. Claude Sonnet 5.5 joins the text catalog, while GPT Image gains another route around certain Azure regional failures.

The new `/v1/messages` endpoint accepts Anthropic Messages requests from Claude Code and Anthropic SDKs. Claude Code can also use eight Fireworks text model routes that previously rejected its cache markers. Polli gained 3D generation, embeddings, voice changing, speech isolation, and Hermes Agent integration; harness defaults now select an available tool-calling model. Image input to text-only models now returns a clear error instead of being silently dropped.

A new GitHub-issue survey asks what people build, what Pollinations cannot yet do for them, and what it gets wrong. Qualifying written responses can earn 3 Quest Pollen once per GitHub account. Follow-up changes made the form easier to find and broadened its answer options; reward checks now use the survey label and require at least 60 characters across the two main written answers.

highlights.title: Lightning Image Turbo
highlights.text: Generate images with `inferenceport-ai/lightning-image-turbo`, using up to two reference images for visual guidance. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=inferenceport-ai/lightning-image-turbo).

highlights.title: Separate audio into stems
highlights.text: Upload audio to `/alpha/audio/stem-separation` and get a ZIP containing vocals and instrumental, or six separate stems including drums, bass, guitar, and piano. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Gemini 3.5 transcription
highlights.text: Transcribe audio with `google/gemini-3.5-transcribe`; response options include word timestamps and speaker labels. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-3.5-transcribe).

highlights.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5
highlights.text: Use `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` for text, images, tools, and adaptive reasoning, with a 1M-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5).

highlights.title: Anthropic Messages endpoint
highlights.text: Point Claude Code or an Anthropic SDK at `/v1/messages` with a bearer token to use supported Pollinations text models. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Generate 3D from Polli
highlights.text: Use `polli gen 3d` with a prompt or image, then save the generated `.glb` or `.ply` file. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Embeddings from the terminal
highlights.text: Use `polli gen embeddings` with arguments or newline-separated input; vectors come back in input order. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: More audio tools in Polli
highlights.text: Use `polli gen voice-change` to re-speak local audio in another voice, or `polli gen isolate` to remove music and background noise from audio or video. Speech generation can also save character-level alignment with `--timestamps`. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Hermes Agent meets Polli
highlights.text: Configure Hermes Agent with Pollinations models using `polli harness hermes`, and manage its hosted MCP servers with `polli mcp`. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Take the Bee Census
highlights.text: Tell us what you build, what you tried to build but couldn't, and what we get wrong. A qualifying written GitHub survey response can earn 3 Quest Pollen once per account.

highlights.title: Two more speech voicesets
highlights.text: Generate speech with `openai/tts-1` or higher-quality `openai/tts-1-hd` through `/audio/{text}` and `/v1/audio/speech`. Both offer six voices and six output formats. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
